The A$55.00 Medicare amount is the TOTAL for the consult plus the lab. The consult alone is A$32.95. Rebates follow the Medicare schedule fee, so they do not rise with the consult price. Booking order: the client books the test, then books the consult. The consult is 1 to 28 days before the test, or the same morning before the test. The booking page warns the client to stay fasted if she has the test straight after. Checkout shows the full price but charges only the GTT amount. Medical pays Lounge a flat market room fee (inside the group, no profit effect). Plan: 100% Package 1. Afternoon pricing: not changed, to be figured out in time.
